No, you shouldn't have to pay for Standard shipping on that order. $40 + $45 = $85, and after the $10 code your total is **$75**. Standard shipping is free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax), so you just meet the threshold.

- **Express** isn't free. It costs $14.95 and isn't available in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, plus remote and island addresses).
- **XL plants** (usually over 4 ft) add a $20 handling fee and ship Standard only. That fee is separate from the shipping charge.
- **Standard delivery times** are 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2 and 5-8 in Zone 3.
- **Dispatch day:** live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. A plant order placed after 12 noon on Wednesday ships the following Monday, and mixed orders ship together on a plant day.

The $75 is exact, so if the discounted total drops below that, shipping will cost $7.95.
